summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K to announce routine bitcoin purchases (17.76 BTC at ~$59,850 each) and provide periodic updates on its holdings of cash, bitcoin, and its Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock of Strategy Inc. The filing also discloses shares outstanding and a historical balance sheet summary. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is involved. This is a standard periodic disclosure of treasury operations and holdings.
